# Data Handling Risk

When fetching issues, keys that do not correspond to existing issues are silently omitted from the result. This could lead to assumptions about data integrity if users expect all provided keys to return valid data.

- `knowledge_compiler/collectors/jira.py` — `knowledge_compiler.collectors.jira.AtlassianJiraGateway.get_issues`
